name: LLaMA Decoder-Only Transformer
description: Decoder forward pass with a LayerNorm before attention

data.noteContent:
GPT's original block normalises after each sub-layer; LLaMA normalises before it. Pre-norm leaves the residual path unnormalised from top to bottom, which is what makes very deep stacks train without a long warmup.

Two honest gaps. The paper's norm is RMSNorm, a cheaper variant that skips the mean subtraction; the canvas has LayerNorm, so that is what is drawn. And one LayerNorm sits in front of the whole stack here, where a real block has one before attention and one before the feedforward.

The input is a random tensor: the wiring and the shapes, not a trained model.

GPT 原本的區塊是在每個子層之後才做正規化，LLaMA 則是之前。pre-norm 讓殘差那條路徑整段保持沒被正規化過，很深的堆疊才不必靠長長的 warmup 才訓得起來。

有兩個要說清楚的落差。論文用的是 RMSNorm，一種省掉減平均的簡化版；畫布只有 LayerNorm，所以畫的是 LayerNorm。另外這裡只有一個 LayerNorm 擺在整個堆疊前面，真正的區塊則是 attention 前一個、feedforward 前一個。

輸入是隨機張量：看的是接線與形狀，不是訓練好的模型。

normalized_shape 32 means it normalises across the feature dimension, one token at a time - never across the sequence. This is the 'pre' in pre-normalisation, applied once in front of the stack.

normalized_shape 32 表示它沿特徵維度正規化，一次一個 token — 不會跨序列。這就是 pre-normalization 的「pre」，只是在這裡只套在整個堆疊前面一次。

The id says last_token, but the node is a Mean: it averages all 16 positions. A real next-token head reads the final position only, the one that has seen the whole prompt.

節點 id 寫的是 last_token，但它其實是 Mean：把 16 個位置全部平均。真正的 next-token 頭只讀最後一個位置，因為那個位置才看過整段輸入。
